What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number isn’t updating, it’s usually because the carrier hasn’t scanned the package yet. This can happen even after the shipping label is created.
Here are a few things you can do:
Check your email (including spam/junk) for tracking notifications.
Log into your Living Spaces account and review the order details for the tracking link.
Use the carrier’s tracking page (like UPS) to check for updates.
Sometimes tracking stays unchanged until the carrier physically picks up or scans the shipment.
If tracking still hasn’t updated after the normal 7–10 business day window, it may mean the carrier hasn’t scheduled or scanned the shipment yet.

If your tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package, try these steps:
Check around your home (front door, porch, package lockers, side entrances) in case the carrier left it nearby.
Review the tracking details to confirm the delivery address and any delivery notes or photos.
Contact the shipping carrier (for example UPS) and file a missing package claim using your tracking number.
Sometimes “delivered” can also mean the package reached a local carrier hub or was handed to the carrier for final delivery, so the carrier can help confirm the exact status.
